sobreMi.p1: Hi, I'm Juan Diego, a Software Development student passionate about building modern and functional web solutions.
sobreMi.p2: I'm currently learning React, building real projects and improving every day. I believe well-written code is a form of art.

hitos.descripcion: I took my first steps in programming by learning Python. Logic, variables, functions — the foundation of everything.
I entered web development with HTML and CSS. I learned to build and style pages from scratch.
I learned React by building this portfolio from scratch. Components, hooks, state, deployment on Vercel.
Continuing my journey, learning every day and building projects that bring me closer to the job market.
